test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘CALIBER’ is written as ‘ECNGDGT’ and ‘BURNING’ is written as ‘DWTLKPI’. How will ‘AUCTION’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘CALIBER’ is written as ‘ECNGDGT’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d25a1498a80a71278215ecee842c81fdbd0a0cc83a830975d9e98ed82a15ed4.png] 

‘BURNING’ is written as ‘DWTLKPI’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4986f28fccc085b2a2d057ba72edae569a1be2dffba88100473f9ed5543aa622.png] 

Similarly, ‘**AUCTION**’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df1bdc6e6931057b4f26b803077f4ac2b1ee38ba3fefaf1f412b179e0143589a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**CWERKQP**".
